item.description: ### Fixed - **Phone alerts keep working when your Perch Pro subscription ends and you also own the $29 licence.** Perch kept signing alerts with the Pro key after it lapsed, so every alert was turned away, and removing the key did not help: alerts to your phone stayed off for about a month. Perch now notices that a key has been refused, switches to a licence you hold that still works, and moves your phone's registration across. Nothing to do on your side.
